pages.title: Your First Tools
pages.text: Before you can work with metal, you need basic stone tools.$(br2)Start by finding §6surface cobblestone blocks§r scattered on the ground. They look like small rocks on the surface.$(br2)Pick them up and use them in the crafting table to make your first tools.
§3Cobblestone Hammer§r$(br)Attack: 3, Durability: 96$(br)Used for forging metal on anvils.
§3Handle Stone Hammer§r$(br)Attack: 4, Durability: 256$(br)An upgraded hammer with a handle.
§3Stone Chisel§r$(br)Attack: 2, Durability: 48$(br)Used for carving finished products from metal.
§3Flint Knife§r$(br)Used for cutting grass to get grass fiber, and for various crafting tasks.
§3Flint Shovel§r$(br)Right-click sand/gravel to extract raw clay. Right-click dirt to dig a kiln pit.
§3Flint Sickle§r$(br)Right-click grass to obtain grass fiber, same efficiency as the flint knife.
§3Wooden Clamp (Tongs)§r$(br)§cCRITICAL:§r Must use this to pick up hot items from fire pits! Bare hands will burn you.

pages.title: Tool Usage Tips
pages.text: $(li)§6Hammer + Anvil:§r Left-click on anvil to forge metal$(br)$(li)§6Axe + Anvil:§r Right-click on anvil to bend metal sheets$(br)$(li)§6Chisel + Anvil:§r Left-click on anvil to carve finished products$(br)$(li)§6Flint Shovel:§r Right-click sand for clay, dirt for kiln pit$(br)$(li)§6Flint Knife:§r Right-click grass for grass fiber$(br)$(li)§6Wooden Clamp:§r Always use for hot items!
